Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

On the college dorm tour, we visited the rooms of two different students - one who was thin and one who was fat. The student who was thin had clothes and books strewn all over the floor, whereas the student who was fat did not. Whose room was sloppy?
A. Cannot be determined
B. The one who is fat
C. The one who is thin
